parts.text: 客测环境可以访问。我来查找该环境实际加载的 buildinginfo 产物。

tool_input.command: $u='http://58.210.252.230:9002'; $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; $html=$r.Content; "LEN=$($html.Length)"; echo '=== 所有 assets 引用 ==='; ([regex]'assets/[^"'']+').Matches($html) | Select-Object -First 15 | ForEach-Object { $_.Value }; echo '=== version.json ==='; try { $v=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$u/version.json" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; $v.Content } catch { "no version.json: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
